# RELIEF360 — Expected Test Baseline Outputs

This directory will contain baseline "golden" output files used to verify system correctness:

1. **`APPS_DEDUP_EXP.dat`:** Expected deduplicated output after DFSORT (`PREP-APP`).
2. **`APPS_APPROVED_EXP.dat`:** Expected approved allocations with calculated priority scores and capped aid (`ELIG`).
3. **`RECON_MATCH_EXP.dat`:** Expected matched payment reconciliation records (`RECON`).
4. **`EXCEPTIONS_EXP.dat`:** Expected exception listings containing categorized error codes.
5. **`REPORT_SUMMARY_EXP.txt`:** Expected formatted printable report output (`REPORT`).
